setup: CREATE TABLE ordered AS SELECT i, CASE WHEN i%17=16 THEN NULL ELSE i%5 END AS k FROM range(50000) t(i)

workloads.name: ordered_sum_total_key_elision
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i ORDER BY k) FROM ordered

workloads.name: ordered_first_last_ungrouped_ties_nulls
workloads.sql: SELECT first(i ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST), last(i ORDER BY k NULLS LAST) FROM ordered

workloads.name: ordered_first_last_grouped_high_cardinality
workloads.sql: SELECT first(i ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST), last(i ORDER BY k NULLS LAST) FROM ordered GROUP BY i%8192

workloads.name: ordered_first_last_grouped_ties_nulls
workloads.sql: SELECT first(i ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST), last(i ORDER BY k NULLS LAST) FROM ordered GROUP BY i%64

workloads.name: ordered_first_last_mixed_sum_grouped
workloads.sql: SELECT sum(i), first(i ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST), last(i ORDER BY k NULLS LAST) FROM ordered GROUP BY i%64

workloads.name: ordered_first_last_composite_fallback
workloads.sql: SELECT first(i ORDER BY k NULLS FIRST, i), last(i ORDER BY k NULLS LAST, i) FROM ordered
